user.title: Connect to the ASUS AiMesh controller
user.description: Uses read-only SSH commands to collect 2.4 GHz radio and client diagnostics. SSH must be enabled on every AiMesh node and use the same credentials. Leave username and password blank to reuse credentials from an existing AsusRouter entry for this host.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the router over SSH
error.missing_credentials: Enter SSH credentials or configure AsusRouter for this host first
error.unsupported_router: No supported AiMesh 2.4 GHz interfaces were found
